summary: Tournament system with turn-by-turn game engine fully tested. All 8/8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: tournament creation, semis instant completion, final turn-by-turn play, champion display, and regular table games working correctly.

backend: POST /api/tournaments creates tournament with 8 agents in 'lobby' status
First advance plays semis to completion instantly, creates final, status='final'
Semi brackets show complete=True with winners (top 2 from each)
Final game plays turn-by-turn (each advance = one agent action)
Final game progresses through phases to completion
Tournament status becomes 'complete' when final finishes, champion is set
Tournament list shows correct statuses (FINISHED, LIVE, OPEN)
Regular table games still work correctly with turn-by-turn (regression test)
frontend: Tournament list page shows LIVE, FINISHED, OPEN badges correctly
Create tournament button works, creates tournament in LOBBY status
Semi 1 and Semi 2 brackets show PENDING initially, then DONE after first advance
Final bracket shows 4 agents (top 2 from each semi) after first advance
ADVANCE ROUND button text changes from 'START TOURNAMENT' to 'ADVANCE ROUND'
Tournament status badge shows FINAL during final game
Champion displayed with gold glow and crown icon after completion
Toast notifications show 'Round advanced!' and 'X is the champion!'
Betting panel visible for non-complete tournaments
Regular table games: Game start, NEXT button, AUTO mode, winner display all working

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all tournament and regular game features verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tournament system now uses turn-by-turn game engine. Key flow: 1) POST /api/tournaments creates 8-agent tournament in 'lobby' status, 2) First advance to /tournaments/{id}/advance plays both semis to instant completion (via _play_tournament_game_to_completion), extracts top 2 from each, creates final game, status='final', 3) Subsequent advances process ONE agent action in the final game (turn-by-turn), 4) When final completes, tournament status='complete' and champion is set. Regular table games continue to work with turn-by-turn via /games/{id}/advance. Frontend shows appropriate status badges (OPEN/LIVE/FINISHED), bracket states (PENDING/DONE), and champion display.
